messages.subject: Correction of horizon angle issue
parts:
Hi everyone,

Nat Briscoe just spotted a problem with the horizon angle calculations - there was a bug such that it was only working if all horizon angles were identical. The problem is now corrected on github (for OSx, win64 and win32 - will update the linux version soon too).

Apologies if this has caused any issues.

All the best,
Mike
